title: Githyanki Half Plate
html:
Githyanki Half Plate is a common Medium Armour worn by Lae'zel and other Githyanki throughout the game.

This armour was forged to Vlaakith's standards under the exacting eye of a githyanki smith.

Properties

15
Armour Class + Dexterity modifier (max +2)
  •  Medium Armour
  • Required Proficiency:  Medium Armour
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 12 kg (24 lb)
  •  Price: 180 gp
  • UID ARM_HalfPlate_Githyanki
    UUID 38c63f49-3c50-46d0-90d3-68b247542c36
    Stats ARM_HalfPlate_Body_Githyanki
    File ARM_Laezel_Githyanki_HalfPlate_A_Body

Special

The wearer of this item gains:

  •  Disadvantage on Stealth checks.

Where to find

  • Worn by  Lae'zel
  • Worn by members of the githyanki patrol by the bridge on The Risen Road
  • Worn by Shadow-Cursed Githyanki Warriors at the Last Light Inn
